methodology: Ten-verse sequential Arabic/translation thematic screen, with bounded earlier-text checks. Candidate only when specific source text and relationship can be identified. No original-language critical collation or manuscript comparison in this pass; no public promotion.

rows.theme: Condemnation of killing prophets and advocates of justice

candidates.relationship: specific earlier motif: killing admonishing prophets
candidates.similarity: Both condemn the killing of prophets who oppose wrongdoing.
candidates.difference: Nehemiah 9:26 is a retrospective confession about Israel's ancestors and prophets calling for return; Qur'an 3:21 condemns killers of prophets AND those commanding justice and announces punishment.
candidates.edition_checked: English translations inspected (ESV and other translations); Hebrew critical edition not collated
